note: One source, one curation tree: each native family carries one independent claim, separable by column, native subject and entry locator, so the claims share one prepare per step. Expected values are the replaced tests' assertions restated at the build boundary; a null provider key surfaces as unresolved_catalog_identity on the native family. Authored from the reviewed sources, built from the drifted ones. Families 11 and 12 use a digest-only owner, the harder form: an owner with `expected_records` must also carry the same digest (the loader refuses one without it), and the compiler compares both. The step-1 outcomes of the undrifted families must hold unchanged. Families 13, 20-23 are the component-level drift legs of the narrowed digests (maintainer decision 5): each digest covers its guarded originals' own content, not the delivery revision. 13's own original changes a field (an operational definition) and 20's originals a parent fact (variant 13's description): both owners go stale and their columns stay unowned and unresolved, as 11/12 do. 21's originals are unchanged, so its owner still applies although the delivery changed. For the coding digest, 22's original changes the same parent fact, so its stored text role is stale and the attached list publishes (as for 15), while 23's original and list are unchanged and its role still applies with its warning.
fails_if: any one of: `compile_partitions` stops comparing an `[[identity.unassigned]]` digest with the complete originals (5); `_scoped_column_owners` stops comparing a digest-only owner's `expected_evidence_sha256` with every matched original, so a removed (11) or added (12) original leaves the owner applied; the `[[coding.uncoded]]` coding evidence digest stops covering the original's fields (15) or its bound list (16); or an owner or `[[coding.uncoded]]` digest stops covering a guarded original's fields or parent facts, so 13, 20 or 22 still applies; or a digest again covers the delivery revision or other records of the delivery, so 21's owner or 23's role goes stale although its own originals are unchanged
